mapper.insert: insert into red_packet (id, conversation_id, sender_id, total_amount, total_count, remain_amount, remain_count, type, greeting, status) values (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{totalAmount}, #{totalCount}, #{remainAmount}, #{remainCount}, #{type}, #{greeting}, #{status})
mapper.update: update red_packet set remain_amount = remain_amount - #{amount}, remain_count = remain_count - 1 where id = #{redPacketId} and remain_count > 0 and status = 0
mapper.select: select count(*) from red_packet_record where red_packet_id = #{redPacketId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into red_packet_record (red_packet_id, user_id, amount) values (#{redPacketId}, #{userId}, #{amount})
mapper.update: update red_packet set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
